results.content:
The New York Fed’s Survey of Consumer Expectations for July, released on Aug. 7, shows short-term inflation expectations edged down by 0.1 percentage point while medium and longer-term held steady. Perceptions about the current financial situation improved from a year ago, with a larger share of households reporting a better financial situation compared to those reporting a worse one.
